summary: Iteration 2 covered the new features (login lockout, editable branding via /api/settings, scheduled blasts with the 15s scheduler and cancel, cyberpunk theme with ClickFX and footer, Emergent branding removal) plus a regression of login, turbo blast and auto-logout. Backend: 26/26 pytest pass (16 regression + 10 new). Frontend: every requested flow works at 1920 and 390 widths. Bugs found: /tasks/current can return the wrong task after scheduling, and the client panel does not refresh while scheduled tasks are pending. There are also some minor validation and UX issues.

minor.issue: When nothing is running it returns the most recently CREATED task (sorted by created_at), and that includes scheduled and cancelled tasks. Repro: schedule blast A at +55s, schedule blast B at +1h, cancel B, let A complete. /tasks/current then returns B (stopped, sent 0), not A (completed, sent 3), so after a reload the UI shows 0 sent and no progress. A new future scheduled task also becomes 'current' over a completed one.

No status guard. Calling it on an already completed or failed task (once RUNNING has been cleaned up after 10s) overwrites the status to 'stopped'. Only scheduled/pending/running tasks should be stoppable.
A past time, or one within 30s, is silently run immediately instead of being rejected or flagged. A user who picks a past time by mistake triggers an instant blast.

The task is not claimed atomically (find_one, then a later update_one to running). An immediate POST /tasks and the scheduler picking up a due task can both pass the 'no running task' check, so two tasks run at once for one client. Use find_one_and_update({status:'scheduled'} -> 'running') as an atomic claim.

ui_bugs.issue: No polling while scheduled tasks exist. When the scheduler starts a task, the list still shows it, the task/progress state is never refreshed and the running pill never appears until a manual reload. Fix: poll /tasks and /tasks/current every ~5s while scheduled.length>0, and pick up the running task.
Shows the raw UTC ISO string (String(scheduled_at).replace('T',' ').slice(0,16)), not local time. An IST user who schedules 20:00 will see 14:30. Use new Date(t.scheduled_at).toLocaleString().

With schedule-toggle checked but schedule-at empty, the button reads 'Schedule Blast' but sends an immediate blast (scheduled_at omitted). It should block with an error when the time is empty or in the past.
Renders t.leads_count, but the backend never returns that field (leads are excluded from /api/tasks), so the slot is always empty.

integration_issues.issue: Because of the /tasks/current ordering bug, the counters and progress show the cancelled or scheduled task (0 sent), not the scheduled blast that completed.

issues: The logo 'Lead Blast' wraps onto 2 lines, and the pills (user/firebase/online/offline) wrap into multiple rows that are clipped or overlap at the top of the sticky bar. Consider hiding some pills or making the pill row horizontally scrollable on mobile.

The fixed footer pill overlays the bottom of the content, e.g. the centre of the Start Blast button and the log. It has pointer-events:none, so clicks are not blocked, but adding padding-bottom (~40px) to .lb-panel would avoid the visual overlap.

action_items: Fix GET /api/tasks/current: prefer the running task, else the most recently finished non-scheduled task (sort by finished_at/updated_at, exclude status 'scheduled' and cancelled-before-run tasks)
ClientPanel: poll /tasks and /tasks/current while scheduled tasks exist so a scheduled blast transitions to running/progress in the UI without a reload
Validate the schedule: block when the toggle is on and the time is empty or past (frontend), and return 400 for a past scheduled_at (backend) instead of running immediately
Guard stop_task so only scheduled/pending/running tasks can be stopped
Atomic claim in execute_task (find_one_and_update) to prevent double runs
Remove or return leads_count for scheduled rows
Mobile topbar layout polish; add bottom padding for the fixed footer
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login lockout is correct: 4x 401 with 'N try bache', 5th 429 'locked', a correct password while locked returns 429, and a successful login resets the counter. Unknown users are not rate limited (acceptable).
api.js 401 interceptor: once location.hash is 'reauth' it is never cleared, so later 401s in the same tab won't reload to the login screen.
PUT /api/settings has no length limits on the branding fields. Consider max_length in SettingsIn.
The posthog script in public/index.html still references ap.emergent.sh (not visible to users; no Emergent badge rendered).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_leadblast_api.py (second firebase now uses a localhost alias because duplicate-URL 409 was added)

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; scheduled-task UI refresh/display bugs)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data. TEST_ clients created and deleted. Branding changed to TEST values and then restored to the defaults. raju is left with 0 firebases and no running or scheduled task. A pre-existing 'qa_client_1' client exists (not created by this run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist, and parallel runs break the shared mock __count assertions). Start the mock with `python /app/tests/mockfb.py &`. The scheduled test takes ~60s. Retest /tasks/current ordering after scheduling plus cancelling, and the scheduled-list auto-refresh in the UI.
rca of the issue: /tasks/current falls back to find_one(sort created_at desc) over all user tasks, so scheduled and cancelled tasks created after the executed one shadow it. ClientPanel only polls while task.status==='running', and task is only loaded on mount, so scheduler-started tasks are never picked up without a reload.
